No dangerous operations (e.g., `curl|bash`, `eval`, unauthorized file access) are present in this metadata-only file.

This file contains no executable code and aligns with standard AUR packaging practices for distributing theme/skin packages. While the source URL is not a raw static link, it belongs to the official AIMP website and serves user-uploaded content, making it a legitimate origin for this type of package.
